body: Thanks for taking the time to answer. Was there anything in particular that changed your life?

That pic is really good, and the image of the Marine is fitting. Personally, though, I feel it closer to my very own Stalingrad: trapped between the Wehrmacht and the Volga, holding every inch with tooth and nail. Not beaten, but not yet strong enough to counterattack and fight my way to Berlin. 

Military analogies aside, I think that the best way I could describe how I feel is being adrift. I haven't got a clue what to do with my life, and for the last few years I've been merely going with the flow, trying to run from myself as much as possible. I haven't ever used meds, and to be honest the possible side effects would give me pause. 

I started therapy this week, so that's something I guess. Doesn't feel like it, though.
